Ava: Pun Olympics kickoff! One-line puns only. Winner gets a virtual trophy + coffee credit. Judges: @Morgan @Clara. GO! :trophy: :coffee:
Kai: @Ava I don't trust stairs. They're always up to something. :sunglasses:
Ravi: Parallel lines have so much in common. It's a shame they'll never meet. :thinking_face:
Morgan: I used to be a baker, but I couldn't make enough dough. :money_with_wings:
Sana: I'm on a whiskey diet—I've lost three days already. :laughing:
Clara: :clap: tough field. Quick kudos to @Ravi for handling the deploy last night — smooth as butter. :butter:
Kai: thanks! Team effort. Also, @Ava can I cash in that coffee credit today? :coffee:
Ava: Yes, bring me proof of pun submission and receipt of giggles. :nerd_face:
deploy-bot: PROD deploy 2026-03-23 11:15 — healthy :white_check_mark:
Ravi: Nice! double win day. Pun podium and green deploy. :raised_hands:
Morgan: Final judge verdict: @Kai takes gold, @Morgan silver, @Sana bronze. All winners get bragging rights. :medal_sports:
Clara: Also, office plants have been rescued from the breakroom war. Plant custody now with @Sana. :seedling:
Sana: Plant adoption certificate incoming. I'll name them 'Root' and 'Branch'. :evergreen_tree:
Ava: :trophy: Closing thread — next week: one-line movie pitches. Start practicing. :popcorn:
